about_the_game:
Player character"P-PAN"can fly at any time, so even if you're not good at jumping, don't worry. There are no difficult command inputs or complex switching controls.

Defeat enemies with punches, collect P Points, and use special moves whenever you like.

Repeat this process to progress.

-STORY-

P-PAN lives on Panchu Island, a peaceful island floating in a calm sea.

One day, never-before-seen robots and mysterious creatures suddenly appear around P-PAN's house.

For some reason, they attack P-PAN.

To find out the cause, P-PAN heads to a mysterious structure that has apparently appeared on top of a mountain.

***

P-PAN's special skills are smiling face and endless punches.

Have fun progressing through the game with rapid-fire punches that can be shooted while walking or flying!

(You can shoot in up to three directions with Power-Up Milk.)

- The hot invincible item, "Spicy Cheese"

Getting this item will make you invincible for a certain period of time and allow you to unleash a fiery punch.

It appears frequently throughout the stage, so use it as much as you like.

- Accumulate "P Points" dropped by enemies to unleash two cool "Special Move."

Defeat multiple enemies at once whenever you want. It's great for when you're in a pinch.

- Defeat bosses within the target time to earn a prize!

Prizes are hidden throughout the stages too.

In "Collection," you can view your collected prizes.

Collect them all and make P-PAN's house even more luxurious.

- Original, slightly cheesy yet fun background music

It's a bold theme that may stick in your head.

- A stage select system lets you replay any stage you've cleared at any time.

Six unique stages all playthrough takes about 30 minutes. Once you've cleared the entire all game, a "secret stage" will appear.

Your score is also displayed. If you're confident in your skills, brag about your high score.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows10+
  • Memory: 500 MB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: If the program cannot be started due to a missing dll file, need to install the Microsoft Visual C++ package.

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows10+
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Armed with a big smile and punches that fly endlessly, have fun progressing! P-PAN can fly and hovering, so even if you're not good at jumping, this 2D action shooter is a fun choice.
